text: Milk is kept hot for hours, far longer than for pasteurising, so it browns and boils down a little without being cooked to a skin. Traditionally it stood in a Russian stove; dairies now hold it in closed, stirred tanks.

steps.note: The milk is stirred, so no fat layer or protein clumps form on top.
